Three tools that turn Claude into a video editing team.

First, Remotion: say ”make the captions bigger,“
and it changes one line of code and renders the video again.

then exports them as a video file with captions on top.

and it handles the script, footage, music, and captions all the way to a finished cut.

All three are on GitHub and free for individuals,
and Claude can even run the install commands for you.

Addy Osmani, an engineer on Anthropic‘s Claude Code team, says the more we hand off to AI, the faster our ability to check its work fades:
”When you’re producing more than you can stand behind, you‘re no longer reviewing. You’re hoping.“
When plausible answers keep piling up, we skim, pass them on, and eventually take AI‘s answer as our own thought.
He calls this ”cognitive surrender.“
In Anthropic’s own experiment, people who asked why the AI wrote the code that way scored 86%,
while those who handed it over entirely scored 39%.

Two prompts are enough to make your Claude Code setup improve every day.

Kun Chen shared the method on X.
First, ask an AI agent to plan logging detailed enough to replay what users experienced, the internal operations, and the visible outcomes.
Then run a prompt once a day that reads the past 24 hours of logs, finds broken behavior, user friction, and inefficiencies, and proposes improvements sorted by estimated impact.

In Claude Code, you paste the first prompt into a chat and put the second one in a scheduled task.
Use a desktop scheduled task if it needs your local files, or a cloud scheduled task if it should run while your computer is off.

If your program collects telemetry from users, the post says aggregated analysis gives even better results.
The post, from October 26, passed 1,700 likes.

You can now make motion graphics without Claude.

OpenDesign released Motion on October 15
as an open-source alternative to Claude Motion.

and it builds the video as an editable source file and an MP4.

and each model came back with different colors and layouts.

and describe the text and motion you want to change.

댓글에 ‘모션’ 남겨주시면 가이드 보내드릴게요!

My plain clip turned into this, for free? 🎬

I uploaded one 15-second video to the Many Lies preset on Higgsfield Katana,
tapped Recreate in Claude, and sent the command it gave me to Claude.
The edit was ready in about a minute.

Nothing new is generated here.
Your own footage is cut into a 48-slot edit template,
so no credits are used, and my transaction history showed no charge.

Presets that generate new scenes do cost credits,
so I wrote up when it stays free and every step in order.

Foresight는 회의 중에 단어 몇 개만 적어 두면

Google just released an AI meeting notes app for Mac with no subscription fees.

Jot down a few words during a meeting, and Foresight fills them in with what was actually said.
When a question comes up, it pulls an answer and its source from the files you‘ve connected.

Your recordings and files never leave your Mac,
and it keeps working offline, even on a plane.

For now, it’s available as an experimental app for Apple silicon Macs.

I uploaded a photo to ChatGPT and sent a single line of code like /lego,
and she turned into a LEGO figure from her face down to her pants.

이제 클로드도 참지 않습니다, 계속 욕하면 대화에서 쫓겨나요 🚫

앤트로픽이 11월 12일부터 적용할 새 이용 정책을 공개했는데
클로드에게 이유 없이 욕설과 잔인한 행동을 반복하는 걸 금지 항목에 넣었어요.

답답해서 내는 짜증이나 모델 테스트는 해당하지 않고
대응은 클로드가 그 대화를 직접 끝내는 방식입니다.

동의 없이 사람을 추적하는 것, 자율 기기에 무기를 다는 것도 이번에 금지됐어요.

도덕적 지위는 모른다면서도 대비부터 해두는 쪽을 택한 건데,
AI를 도구로만 볼지에 대한 질문이 이제 약관 안으로 들어왔습니다.

Claude won‘t put up with it anymore. Keep abusing it and you get kicked out of the chat.

Anthropic has published an updated Usage Policy that takes effect on November 12.
It adds a new prohibition on sustained and needless abusive or cruel behavior toward its models.

Ordinary frustration and model testing are not covered.
The main response is Claude ending the conversation itself.

The update also bans tracking people without consent and arming drones or other autonomous vehicles.

Anthropic says it is still highly uncertain whether Claude has moral status, but it chose to prepare anyway.
The question of whether AI is just a tool has now made its way into the terms of use.

같은 일을 시켜도 전작 Haiku 4.5보다
평균 75% 적은 비용으로 끝나는데,
컴퓨터 조작 시험은 72.4%로 GPT-6 Luna보다 높았어요.

from the day it was made until now.

AI videos are usually made by video generation models that create the whole screen for you,

day 0, reading a lot, learning and correcting again,

A model that finishes in 0.1 seconds what LLMs took 8.5 seconds to decide.

TypeSafe AI released Jev on September 15.
It is the first model from the company founded by Diogo Almeida, who worked on ChatGPT at OpenAI,
and it never writes text: it only returns a choice, a score, or a true-or-false probability.

In the official comparison, an LLM took 8.566 seconds and Jev took 0.114 seconds on the same task,
which the company sums up as 193.6x faster and 444.6x cheaper.
Input costs $0.042 per million tokens and output is free.
